newsitem.title: USA: Edison says NYSE to delist its shares.
newsitem.headline: Edison says NYSE to delist its shares.

text.p: Specialty retailer Edison Brothers Stores Inc said Friday the New York Stock Exchange said it does not intend to resume trading in the company's shares and plans to delist the stock.

This action has no effect on the retailer's plan to emerge from Chapter 11 bankruptcy proceedings and plans to cancel its existing common stock, said Daivd Cooper, Edison chief financial officer, in a news release.
"We expected this action and appreciate the fact that the Exchange has allowed trading to continue until this point in the Chapter 11 process," he said.
A confirmation hearing on Edison's plan of reorganization is scheduled for August 14. Edison said it expects to emerge from Chapter 11 within 30 days of the plan's confirmation.
Edison operates more than 1,700 stores in the United States, Canada, Puerto Rico and the Virgin Islands.
